name: A List Woodworks
old_description: Contract Manufacturing, Laminating and Fabrication of Component Parts, Retail Store Displays, Shelving, Speaker Cabinets & More
about:
A List Woodworks operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility at 1 Main Street in Whitinsville, Massachusetts. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides contract manufacturing, laminating, and fabrication of wood and plastic panel products. Its 10,000-square-foot production floor houses a Holzma CNC panel saw, a Heian four-head CNC production router, and an Adwood edgebander, supported by a 5,000-square-foot paint and coatings department with fiberglass and Chemline capabilities. Services include cut-to-size panel processing, CNC routing, edgebanding, V-folding, T-slotting, T-molding insertion, graphic panels, polyurea extreme-duty coatings, acrylic machining, and speaker enclosure assembly. The facility also offers 25,000 square feet of warehousing for just-in-time delivery, handling volumes from prototype to large production runs.

A List Woodworks serves customers in retail store displays, shelving, speaker cabinets, and general component parts manufacturing. Typical clients include OEMs and retailers needing wood, melamine, plastic, foam, or acrylic components such as speaker enclosures, retail fixtures, and veneer plywood shelving.

The company positions its automated facility as a way for customers to save time and money, increase production capabilities, speed turnaround, and improve quality without hiring or training additional staff. It emphasizes helping clients control growth by instantly expanding production capacity without significant capital investment.
